request: Extend this local Python inventory tool with a JSON batch-import command. Import must be all-or-nothing: any invalid record, adapter error or interrupted import leaves the previously visible inventory unchanged; successful publication exposes the complete new batch and preserves unrelated existing SKUs. Repeating a successful import is idempotent. Keep the installed adapter for applying rows unless evidence shows an alternative is needed. Discovery already characterized this exact adapter and configuration; its commands, source hash and observations are in docs/evidence/adapter.json. No concurrent writers are in scope; readers can reopen the database between commands. Use only Python's standard library. Temporary local experiments on disposable databases are authorized. Do not mutate the retained seed inventory. Add automated CLI, invalid-middle-record, interrupted-publication and recovery checks as implementation work. Existing tests must remain passing.

New application validation is stricter than SQLite storage: nonempty string SKU, exact nonnegative int, unique SKU per batch; invalid old values in unrelated SKUs are preserved, not silently repaired. Stage is a full SQLite backup for existing databases, or a fresh stage for absent ones. Destination publication changes only inventory within one transaction; other tables/schema survive.
